'''Nelson''' (Japanese: '''ナオヤ''' ''Naoya'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP259|Entei at Your Own Risk]]''. He is a young [[Pokémon Trainer]] from [[Johto]] who dreams of catching {{p|Entei}}.

Nelson set up a complicated series of tripwires and alarms to detect where Entei would appear, then used his laptop to monitor them. However, the traps were set off by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} instead of Entei. 

Eventually, Entei appeared when {{TRT}} nearly destroyed the hot springs. Nelson's strategy was to use {{m|Mean Look}} to [[Escape prevention|trap]] Entei so he could capture it, but didn't realize that Entei's {{m|Roar}} would cancel out his Mean Look. After discovering this, it only added to Nelson's desire to capture the [[Legendary Pokémon]].

|desc={{p|Misdreavus}} is Nelson's only known Pokémon. It first appeared when it rescued {{AP|Larvitar}} during {{Ash}}'s escape from {{TRT}}'s truck. It was later used in a {{pkmn|battle}} against [[Ash's Phanpy]], where it managed to {{status|confusion|confuse}} it and prevent it from escaping with Mean Look. However, the match was interrupted when Team Rocket netted Misdreavus. With the help of {{AP|Bayleef}}, Misdreavus was saved.

Nelson hoped Misdreavus's Mean Look would prevent {{p|Entei}} from [[Escape|fleeing]], but the [[Legendary Pokémon]] used {{m|Roar}} to end the confrontation.

Misdreavus's known moves are {{m|Headbutt}}, {{m|Swift}}, {{m|Psybeam}}, and {{m|Mean Look}}.}}

Nelson has at least one more Pokémon that was going to be used for the 2-on-2 battle.
